Priya (CS): FYI customer 'Helio Labs' sent back the vendor questionnaire. They want subprocessor list & confirmation on data residency for embeddings. Need answers by EOD Wed. Can we pull the current subprocessor CSV and confirm where embeddings are stored?
Luca (Security): On it — I can pull subprocessors. Quick Q: are they ok with EU-only processing?
Priya (CS): They asked EU-only for PHI-ish stuff. Their legal asked for DPA clause language.
Sam (Legal): I can draft DPA clause. Can we confirm that our hosted embeddings for this account will be pinned to eu-west-1?
Ethan (Eng): For hosted API default, embeddings are stored in our cross-region cache; Dedicated/private customers can pin. For hosted customer, we can request region pinning but need infra ticket.
Maya (Solutions): I can propose a config: customer on Dedicated in eu-west-1 with BYOK KMS. If Helio prefers hosted, ops can enable EU-only tenancy — but will bump cost.
Luca (Security): Subprocessor list attached: aws (eu-west-1), newrelic (monitoring), sendgrid (emails), segment (usage). I'll upload CSV to evidence folder.
security-bot: Evidence uploaded to https://redwood-internal/evidence/1766554321/subprocessors.csv :file_folder:
Priya (CS): Great. Sam — can you draft a short DPA paragraph referencing EU processing + subprocessors list? I'll send it to the customer.
Sam (Legal): Drafted: "We process Customer Data solely within the EU region (eu-west-1) and engage subprocessors listed in the attached CSV; customer may request BYOK and Dedicated deployment for isolated storage." Sending now.
Ethan (Eng): Ops note: To guarantee EU-only for hosted, we need a manual routing flag + cache isolation. ETA for config change ~3 business days.
Maya (Solutions): I'll schedule a 30-min call with Helio for tomorrow 10am CET to walk through options. Priya, can you confirm availability?
Priya (CS): Confirmed. I'll invite them and attach Sam's draft and the subprocessor CSV.
Luca (Security): Also flagged potential renewal risk: if they require SOC2 evidence for processing controls at rest, we should include pointer to SOC2 report and key rotation docs. Putting those links in evidence.
Priya (CS): Adding to the email: SOC2 link + key lifecycle doc. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sam (Legal): One more: include the retention policy for embeddings (30 days) and opt-in deletion procedure.
Ethan (Eng): Current retention is 30 days for embeddings in hosted; Dedicated can shorten if requested.
Priya (CS): Perfect. I'll send draft and set call. Will loop back after call.
Maya (Solutions): If they go Dedicated, estimate procurement + deploy ~2-3 weeks.
Priya (CS): Noted. Thanks all.
